name: How long does it take to repair a leaky faucet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a leaky faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard leaky faucet repairs can be completed within one to three hours, depending on the complexity of the issue and the type of faucet. A simple replacement of a washer or O-ring might take less time, while a more involved repair, such as replacing a cartridge or addressing corroded components, could take longer. Our plumbers work efficiently to diagnose the problem and perform the necessary repairs with minimal disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most leaky faucet repairs take 1-3 hours, depending on the complexity and faucet type.
